detail.longDescription: Rather than having share buttons at the top and bottom of posts, I have just 1 button that copies the URL to clipboard and it automatically removes tracking stuff, if one clicks on my links on, say, Facebook or something. This way, I never have to worry about supporting services ever again. I don't track people with the button, people do the revolutionary thing and contact me to tell me how much they like it/the buttons. 10 people wrote to me already! You can see it on blog entries such as https:// sightlessscribbles.com/posts/m eeting-ray/ # Blog # IndieWeb # Privacy # Blogging # WebDev
